# Bolnivo

> Bolnivo (bolnivo.me) is an AI assistant platform built in Kathmandu, Nepal. Businesses can add assistants to their websites and customer channels to answer questions from approved information and carry out supported workflows. Booking is one capability, alongside customer support and staff handoff.

## Key facts

- Bolnivo was founded in Kathmandu, Nepal by Samrat Ghimire (Founder), with co-founders Aabishkar Shrestha and Kasam Thapa Magar.
  - Samrat Ghimire: https://www.linkedin.com/in/samratghimire01/
  - Aabishkar Shrestha: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aabishkar-shrestha-895492349/
  - Kasam Thapa Magar: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kasamthapamagar/
- Bolnivo answers written messages only; it does not answer phone calls.
- Prices are in Nepali rupees, from Rs. 4,999 per month, with a 14-day free trial.

## Was Bolnivo previously called Vesper?

Yes. Bolnivo is the new name of Vesper, formerly at vesper.codes. Built in Kathmandu, Nepal, Bolnivo provides AI assistants for business websites and customer messaging channels, including workflows such as answering questions and booking appointments. Bolnivo is independent from Vesper AI by Lyfework (vesper.lyfework.io), Vesper Code (vespercode.com), and VesperOps; those are separate products.

## What it does

- Answers customer questions about services, prices and availability using the business's own approved information
- Books, reschedules and cancels appointments against real availability, with Google Calendar sync
- Understands English, Nepali and Romanized Nepali
- Hands the conversation to a human staff member when needed
- Takes booking deposits through eSewa and Khalti
- Built for salons, clinics, hotels and guesthouses, garages, and other appointment-driven businesses

## Channels

- WhatsApp (official Meta Cloud API)
- Instagram Direct Messages
- Facebook Messenger
- Website chat widget
- TikTok messages: coming soon (not live yet)

Bolnivo does not answer phone calls.

## Pricing (NPR, per month)

- Starter: Rs. 4,999
- Pro: Rs. 11,999
- Business: Rs. 19,999

## Language and Nepal

- [Nepali chatbot](https://bolnivo.me/nepali-chatbot): Roman Nepali, Devanagari and Nepali-English mixed chat, with example conversations
- [AI receptionist Nepal](https://bolnivo.me/ai-receptionist-nepal): NPR pricing, eSewa and Khalti deposits, Nepal time

## Problems and intents

- [Appointment booking bot](https://bolnivo.me/appointment-booking-bot): AI appointment scheduler with Google Calendar sync
- [After-hours auto reply](https://bolnivo.me/after-hours-auto-reply): 24/7 replies and night-time bookings
- [Human handoff](https://bolnivo.me/human-handoff): staff inbox with live chat takeover

## Use cases

- [Salons and beauty parlours](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/salons): salon booking chatbot
- [Clinics and dental practices](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/clinics): appointment chatbot, no medical advice
- [Hotels and homestays](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/hotels): reservation requests on WhatsApp
- [Education consultancies](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/consultancies): abroad study inquiries, no visa promises
- [Trekking and tour agencies](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/trekking): multi-day trek bookings by start date
- [Restaurants](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/restaurants): table and private room reservations
- [Gyms](https://bolnivo.me/use-cases/gyms): membership inquiries and session booking
